_doc: Everything in this plugin is manual-only (disable-model-invocation: true) except the commands below. A command earns a place here only when text the plugin installs into a user's project tells an agent to run it unprompted. Enforced by scripts/check-invocation-policy.py.

why.wiki:query: Wiki-First Mandate rule 1 and 'When answering questions' (CLAUDE.wiki.md): query the wiki before answering; --promote new findings.
why.wiki:ingest-meeting: Wiki-First Mandate rule 2 (CLAUDE.wiki.md): the wiki MUST be updated after every content-producing operation.
why.db:sync: project-db CLAUDE.md block rule 3: after changing wiki pages, run /db:sync.
why.ontology:check: project-ontology CLAUDE.md block: check a page or the vault.
why.ontology:propose: project-ontology CLAUDE.md block and the write hook's block message: register a value before using it.
